message: No detected input validation: Command-line arguments are cast directly (int, float, bool) without range checks or schema validation, and data loaders pass inputs to the model without type or value-range guards.

No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from local paths and torchvision datasets (VOC, COCO, Imagenette) with no checksum verification, signed URLs, or pinned revisions to authenticate or verify integrity.

No detected label flipping detection: The code encodes labels from VOC annotations and filters by 'difficult' flag, but performs no distribution comparison, label-value validation against an expected set, or label-noise detection (e.g., Cleanlab).
No detected data poisoning defenses: There is no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checking, or filtering of suspicious training samples anywhere in the data preparation or loading code.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads models and checkpoints (e.g., via torchvision.models and checkpoint loading implied by toLoadCheckpoint) but there is no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision visible anywhere in the provided code slices.
No detected label distribution validation: The code prints dataset sizes but performs no class balance check, expected-label-set validation, or anomalous sample detection before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training loop.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or noise-injection mechanism is imported or used in the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, etc.) or FGSM/PGD attack routines are imported or used anywhere in the evaluation code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of a held-out test set being cryptographically isolated, signed, or hashed; the evaluation simply iterates over a testloader with no integrity checks, and only a single sigmoid-based prediction metric is computed.
No detected input sanitization: The inference path in evaluate.py passes inputs directly to the model after moving to device with no shape, range, or schema validation checks.

No detected output bounds checks: In evaluate.py, Sigmoid outputs are stored directly to a DataFrame and CSV without any NaN guards, probability bounds checks, or sanity validation on the model outputs.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a vision/image classification model (not an LLM), so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
